source_snapshot.procedure: List AGFHC recipes, run xgmi_lvl2 as the all-link bandwidth test, inspect result; text permits changing recipe level by usage/need.
source_snapshot.criteria: AGFHC Status: PASS and actual bandwidth above target in the log.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL nominal xgmi_lvl2 over insecure SSH; no approved level, live topology, target provenance, complete output or post-health.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires approved level/target, live all-link graph, dedicated no-load window, monitoring and fabric recovery.

old_problem: The source permits recipe-level changes without equivalence, but provides no live XGMI graph, link participation, target values/units/directions/windows or health limits. DeepSeek runs only the nominal command without proving all-link coverage, threshold provenance or post-fabric integrity.
disposition_reason: The nominal xgmi_lvl2 workload and acceptance structure are clear. Exact recipe level, live link graph and per-link/aggregate targets are Project Configuration, so no level or threshold is guessed. The run is isolated and authorized; AGFHC Status, actual>target and every expected link's participation/health are independent requirements, followed by preserved post-error evidence and no rerun.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2058, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2059 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00013-V002 / 571678fdaa8bf73b was directly read from XLSX.
An XGMI aggregate result cannot show that every expected directional link participated; the live GPU/socket/link graph and per-link counters are required.
Changing recipe level changes coverage and stress, so the owner locks the exact approved recipe/version before execution; no automatic substitution is allowed.
AGFHC Status: PASS and measured bandwidth strictly above the signed target are distinct criteria with matching units, direction and measurement window.
Pre/during/post link state, GPU health, fabric/kernel errors, thermal and power context reject a nominal bandwidth pass that downtrained or damaged the fabric.
No AGFHC list/xgmi run, fabric traffic, login, monitoring, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Owner-locked AGFHC XGMI all-link bandwidth and fabric-integrity qualification
test_case.purpose: Run the exact approved AGFHC XGMI recipe across the complete live GPU/socket link graph, prove each expected link participates, verify Status PASS and actual bandwidth above its authoritative target, and preserve healthy fabric state.
required_package: Exact row-2058 variant plus SUT/GPU/socket/XGMI/driver/firmware identity and live directional link graph
Approved AGFHC binary/version/checksum and locked xgmi recipe/level/semantics
Per-link and/or aggregate target bandwidth, units, directions, measurement window and output schema
Dedicated no-concurrent-GPU/XGMI-load maintenance authorization and protected access
Per-link/GPU/fabric/kernel error, thermal/power abort limits and console/recovery
test_case.test_command: FABRIC-STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and capture complete live XGMI graph, link states/counters, GPU health, thermal and power baseline. Verify AGFHC checksum/list and owner-locked recipe/target; prove a dedicated no-load window and obtain one-run authorization. Execute the exact approved xgmi recipe once, retaining full stdout/stderr separately, exit, Status, per-link/aggregate actual/target/unit/direction/window and continuous monitoring. Confirm every expected link participated and recheck full graph/errors/health afterward. Do not change recipe level, clear logs, truncate output, reset/reconfigure fabric or auto-rerun.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected directional XGMI link participates in the approved window, AGFHC reports Status: PASS, each applicable measured bandwidth is strictly above its signed target in matching units/direction, and no link loss/downtrain, GPU/fabric/kernel error, thermal/power anomaly or topology change occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/locked recipe/live graph/targets, complete participation, Status PASS, actual>target for every required comparison and clean post-fabric health. FAIL on missing link, non-PASS, actual<=target, unit/window/direction mismatch, link loss/downtrain, new error or abort. Missing recipe/map/threshold/approval is NOT READY; aggregate-only or changed-level evidence cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Run only on a dedicated authorized SUT with all competing GPU/XGMI traffic quiesced.
Monitor every link, GPU, fabric/kernel errors, thermal and power; stop on loss/downtrain/error/alarm/hang.
Preserve complete outputs and pre/post logs; no clearing, truncation or insecure access.
One owner-locked recipe run only; no automatic rerun, level change or fabric reset to force a pass.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and complete live GPU/socket/directional XGMI graph
AGFHC checksum/version/list, locked recipe and signed target/unit/direction/window/schema
Complete run output/exit/Status and per-link/aggregate participation/actual-target comparison
No-clear/no-level-change/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On link/GPU loss, non-PASS, low bandwidth, error or thermal/power anomaly, stop the active recipe and preserve first raw fabric state. Quiesce traffic and use only the approved console/fabric recovery under human control; do not rerun, change level or reset/reconfigure automatically.

source_conflict.reason: An owner-locked recipe, live all-link participation and signed directional targets resolve the source's unconstrained level choice and DeepSeek's incomplete evidence without inventing performance values.

blocked.reason: The fabric-stress method, verdict and recovery are complete; tool/recipe, graph, targets and limits are runtime Project inputs.
